des: Create a .mcp_server_settings.json file in the data directory. You can pick MCP services below or add your own.
More useful MCP services will be added as they are tested; contributions welcome.
Remember to delete the comment lines: the des property is informational only and is not parsed.
The des and link properties only document installation and original links; they are optional.
Three transport modes are supported: stdio, sse (Server-Sent Events), and streamable-http.

streamable-http-mcp-server.des: Uses Streamable HTTP transport mode, suitable for production web deployments
